operations.details: Verified Ordnance Survey Grid InQuest II software guidance.
Full OSTN15/OSGM15 implementation distinguished from reduced or simple transforms.
2016 replacement of legacy models recorded in transformation lineage.
Offline/single/batch capability treated as implementation feature, not accuracy proof.
Verified OS explanation of OSGM15 geoid and height systems.
Ellipsoidal GNSS height separated from national mean-sea-level-based height.
Geoid correction treated as reference conversion, not a physical parcel observation.
LiDAR, GNSS, antenna and sampling errors remain independent of geoid concept.
Horizontal and vertical transformation lineage preserved end to end.
No geoid or transformation value substituted for measured parcel elevation.
Canonical manifest unchanged; serial publisher still required.
